ontology_metadata.title: MEA Ontology — Synthetic Sample
ontology_metadata.description: Minimal synthetic subset of the MEA (Mars–Earth Analog) ontology for reviewer reproducibility testing.
ontology_metadata.note: This is a SYNTHETIC file. It does NOT contain real scientific data. Replace with the full MEA_Ontology.owl for production use.

classes.label: GeologicFeature
classes.description: A physical feature of geological origin on a planetary surface.

classes.label: MorphologicalPattern
classes.description: A recurring geometric or structural pattern observed on planetary surfaces.

classes.label: PolygonalTerrain
classes.description: A terrain type characterised by polygonal networks formed by thermal contraction or desiccation.

classes.label: Location
classes.description: A named geographical or planetary location.

classes.label: GeologicProcess
classes.description: A physical or chemical process that shapes geological features.

classes.label: ThermalProcess
classes.description: A geological process driven by thermal cycling (freeze-thaw, expansion-contraction).

classes.label: MineralComposition
classes.description: The mineralogical makeup of a geological unit.

object_properties.label: formedBy
object_properties.description: Relates a geological feature to the process responsible for its formation.

object_properties.label: analogOf
object_properties.description: Relates a Martian feature to its morphologically or genetically analogous Earth feature.

object_properties.label: foundAt
object_properties.description: Relates a geological feature or mineral to its observed location.

object_properties.label: composedOf
object_properties.description: Relates a geological unit to its constituent minerals.
